profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: May 2020: BS in Computer Science with concentration in Game Development from North Carolina State University. Programmer with experience working on game development projects with a strong background in general software engineering practices as well as many general computer science concepts. Experience working in C, C++, Java, x86 Assembly, Java Script and more.  Has experience developing projects centered around game engine development, game AI development, gameplay story and mechanics design/development and computer graphics development. Has worked on multiple game and interactive narrative projects to get them to a polished initial release state and has experience doing research on how players interact with choices in narrative games.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Worked alongside members of the Teen Health Lab to help develop a new version of their  interactive web-based sexual health program for high school students called Project HEART. The main responsibilities of the job included adding features based on client request, teaching the Lab about Twine and how new features work so that they can add more as needed, and bug testing existing code to allow for the project to be used by users for the lab to collect research data. We reached a working state for the program that allowed the research to begin before the end of my employment.

positions.title: Game Developer
positions.description: Continued work on the Visual Narrative Initiative's project to create a an interactive, historically based, narrative focused, game that uses GPS location to lead you to different landmarks to progress the game. This game was developed in the Unity game engine using C# and involved connecting several different libraries of functionality specifically Mapbox for the GPS and Cradle for the importing and displaying of Twine Narratives. I worked with a small team that included history majors that supplied narrative components, designers who gave graphics, and management who needed periodic reports of progress. My main tasks included getting the libraries to communicate and bringing together all of the teams resources into a final alpha version that would be handed off to other developers.

projects.title: Educational Location-Based Mobile Game Prototype
projects.description: Worked as one of two computer science student developers on a prototype branching-narrative based, educational, mobile game. Worked with a team of 2 design students and one history student to implement a historically accurate story. Held different leadership and following roles during the projects many different phases in order to make a finished project without running into too many issues during collaboration.
